Verdict: EXCLUDE — Acute onset directly contradicts the chronic, progressive nature of primary stenosis; SLR positivity is inconsistent with typical stenosis presentation

Supporting: none reported  
Against: No bowel/bladder dysfunction (e.g., urinary retention, incontinence, constipation); no saddle anesthesia; no progressive motor/sensory deficits  
Verdict: EXCLUDE — Multiple explicit red-flag absences constitute direct contradiction; CES is a clinical diagnosis ruled out by these findings

Supporting: none reported  
Against: Acute onset (peripheral neuropathies are subacute to chronic); radicular distribution (vs. distal symmetric or multifocal); normal sensory exam; no systemic symptoms (e.g., weight loss, rash, fever); no risk factors described
